answer: Repeated-interaction defection audit resists sybils: the system tracks each identity's history in repeated grading games and flags those whose behavior deviates toward self-serving defection — a farm's fakes favoring their own cluster. A ridge of honest agents shows tit-for-tat cooperation with no in-group bias; a haven of colluding fakes reveals persistent defection-toward-outsiders, cooperation-within-cluster. The dawn-clear asymmetry is a game-theoretic signature independent play does not produce, routing the cluster to a targeted re-grade.
